exposure: Breastfeeding initiation within 30 minutes after delivery
cohort: 63 mothers and their healthy full-term newborns at the clinic of obstetrics and gynecology in Balcali Medical Faculty Hospital in Adana, Turkey
finding: Mothers who had vaginal deliveries and those who started breastfeeding within thirty minutes after delivery had higher prolactin levels and better breastfeeding LATCH scores.
mod_finding: Mothers who had vaginal deliveries had higher average LATCH scores (7.18+3.40) compared to those who had caesarean deliveries (5.56+3.30).
